## What changes for a page that uses the library

<!-- What a reader or a developer sees differently. Not how the code changed. -->

## Checked

- [ ] `bun run test` (with the heavy sweeps for a change to streaming or splitting)
- [ ] `bun run check` and `bun run size` after `bun run build`
- [ ] `bun run shots` if a picture in the README changes
- [ ] A changeset (`bunx changeset`) if the package changes
